title: MONSTER_PLUGIN_1
description: A CS:GO-style spin based colour ability SMP plugin with rare powers, secure boxes, and hardcore anti-grief protection.
body:
# 🔥 MONSTER_PLUGIN_1

**MONSTER_PLUGIN_1** is a legendary SMP plugin designed for Paper servers that introduces a **CS:GO-style spin system**, **colour-based abilities**, and a **hardcore anti-grief security system**.

Each player gets **one-time spin on first join**, where they receive a random **Colour Box**. Every colour grants a unique ability, making each player special and different.

---

## 🎮 Spin & Join System
- Automatic rolling spin animation on first join
- One-time spin per player (data saved permanently)
- Re-joining does NOT give another spin
- Admin can reset spin using commands

---

## 🎨 Colour Abilities
- 🔴 **RED** – Strength I + Sharpness-style extra damage  
- 🟢 **GREEN** – Luck II + Auto-Mending for armor & tools  
- 🔵 **BLUE** – Speed II  
- ⚪ **WHITE** – Jump Boost II  
- 🌸 **PINK** – Haste II (fast mining)

---

## 🎡 Rarity System
Each box has a different chance:
- Red: 2% (Ultra Rare)
- Green: 5% (Rare)
- Blue: 13%
- White: 20%
- Pink: 60% (Common)

---

## 🛡️ Anti-Grief & Security
- Boxes cannot be placed, dropped, or stored in chests
- EnderChest protection enabled
- Soulbound system: box never drops on death
- Box is restored automatically on respawn

---

## 💬 Chat Prefix System
Players get a coloured chat tag based on their box.

Example:  
`[RED] Monster: Hello!`

---

## ⚙️ Server Compatibility
- Platform: **Paper**
- Minecraft Version: **1.21.4**
- Optimized for SMP / Hardcore SMP / RPG Servers

---

## 👑 Author
**MONSTER**

> Power is rare. Luck decides your fate.
